# Security policy

Report a suspected vulnerability through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/EternalSelf-2328/undershell/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected undershell version or commit, your Linux distribution,
the feature involved, and the conditions needed to observe the issue. Remove
credentials and personal paths from logs and attachments before sharing them.

Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/EternalSelf-2328/undershell/issues) for
ordinary bugs and feature requests.
